What's your return and refund policy?
All Cozey items come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them (our mattress includes a 100-night trial).
Here are the key details of our return and refund policy:
Free returns: Returning an item is completely free during your 30-day trial, as long as it is returned in its original packaging.
Original packaging: Please keep your original boxes. If any original boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the value of the items needing new boxes (up to a maximum of $150) will be deducted from your refund. (Note: The original packaging is not required for mattress returns).
Inspection & refund timeline: Once we receive your returned product, our Quality Assurance Team will inspect it to ensure there are no customer-caused damages or modifications. After the inspection, please allow 3–7 business days for your refund to be processed.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?
16:00
We offer a 5-year limited warranty on all of our products.
Here are the key details of what it covers and how it works:
What is covered: The warranty covers qualifying manufacturing defects and structural issues, including frame defects, that arise under normal use with appropriate care and maintenance. For example, structural damage caused by a manufacturing defect is covered, and the affected frame component can be replaced.
Evaluated concerns: Issues like cushion flattening, fabric pilling, or snagging are evaluated based on the nature of the issue, how long you've owned the product, its use and maintenance history, and whether a manufacturing defect is present. (Note that gradual softening, light pilling, and normal wear are expected characteristics of upholstered furniture and do not automatically indicate a manufacturing defect).
What voids the warranty: The warranty does not cover consumer-caused damage (accidents, mishandling, improper assembly, neglect, or misuse) or modifications (structural changes, upholstery alterations, or using non-Cozey parts).
Accidental damage: For mishaps not covered by the standard warranty (such as spills, rips, tears, pet incidents, or accidental frame damage), we offer an optional extended protection plan called CozeyProtection+, which must be purchased before your item ships out.
